# discovr

> discovr is a small, hand-picked guide to things worth doing tonight in India: trips, food and drink, local hosts. Eight good picks, not eight hundred. Every listing has been visited by the team.

## Key pages
- [Home: today's picks](https://discovr.in/): the current short list
- [About](https://discovr.in/about): who we are and why
- [How we pick](https://discovr.in/how-we-pick): our rules for listing, prices, verdicts and reviews
- [List with us](https://discovr.in/list-with-us): for hosts and venues
- [Help and contact](https://discovr.in/help): call, WhatsApp or write to the team

## Guides
- [Things to do in Goa](https://discovr.in/goa): hubs by area (Anjuna, Assagao, Vagator and more) and by topic (nightlife, cocktails, kayaking)
- [Nightlife in Goa](https://discovr.in/goa/nightlife): JUNA, The Loft at Ānamiva, RAEETH, Hideaway
- [What to do in Goa at night](https://discovr.in/goa/at-night): cocktails, local bars and clubs together
- [Best sunset spots in Goa](https://discovr.in/goa/sunset-spots): Paloma, Pisco By The Beach, Slow Tide, Bastian Riviera
- [Best cocktails in Goa](https://discovr.in/goa/cocktails): Boilermaker, Drop Dead Sexy, MTW Bar & Toasties
- [Local bars in Goa](https://discovr.in/goa/local-bars): Cajy Bar, Pablo's
- [Kayaking in Goa](https://discovr.in/goa/kayaking): Baga mangroves, Palolem beach
- By area: [Anjuna](https://discovr.in/goa/anjuna), [Vagator](https://discovr.in/goa/vagator), [Assagao](https://discovr.in/goa/assagao), [Arambol](https://discovr.in/goa/arambol), [Baga](https://discovr.in/goa/baga), [Panaji](https://discovr.in/goa/panaji)

## Listings
- [Sitemap](https://discovr.in/sitemap.xml): every experience page, one URL each
